beats.say: The top of Mount Everest used to be the floor of an ocean.
Its rock holds fossils of sea creatures, over four hundred million years old.
About fifty million years ago, India crashed into Asia.
beats.cap: ~50 million years ago: India hits Asia

beats.say: The sea floor between them crumpled up into the Himalayas.
beats.cap: The sea floor became the Himalayas

beats.say: India is still pushing north, a few centimetres a year.
beats.cap: Still moving: a few cm a year

beats.say: So Everest's rock keeps rising, about two millimetres a year.
beats.cap: Everest rock: ~2 mm a year up

beats.say: A twenty twenty-four study says a river may have added up to fifty metres.
The same push brings the earthquakes.
So Everest is an old sea floor, still climbing.
beats.cap: An old sea floor, still climbing
